calls.reason: The packet contains no inspectable prompts or image outputs from Marcus’s runs. His characterization alone cannot establish recurring labeling failures.
Pew documents federal workforce losses, and xAI announces a government contract opportunity. Neither establishes the claimed connection between AI deployment, career job losses, and citizen harms.
WIRED documents a Musk associate’s near-term government AI push, but provides no evaluation establishing bias and unreliability in the proposed systems. Only part of the claim is supported.
GSA procurement access and VA safety concerns do not establish widespread unreliable deployment. The sunscreen disclaimer experiment does not show that most government users ignore warnings.
The 2024 experiments support attitude shifts, limited awareness, and effects despite warnings. But Marcus frames the claim as what can or may happen, which the stated rule classifies as too_early.
